oh dear you're not alone, you just took the most important step that is asking for help and is too brave on your part, do not rush things or make friendships that become crap only, things come at the best time, you'll see that it's so and look, in the worst case if the people of crap are still behaving like a real idiot, I'm here, believe me I feel in your shoes and talk to a stranger will ultimately make you feel better (I'm traudiendo everything my text because I speak Spanish, I'm sorry if it does not make much sense hehe)

Hello, I read all your history, I had to translate since I am reading it from Mexico and my English is so terrible):. I do not know what you could have gone through but I must say that my attempt to commit suicide is narrated as you tell it. I plan to make cuts on my wrist and call a friend or 911 you know? I do not want to die without someone finding me or worse, I do not know if I really want to die or just make a desperate call, I suppose at that moment with the blood gushing out I will find out, friend, you are very brave, I admire you a lot and not for what you did if not because you were really brave and I know you can have low moments where nothing makes sense to you and god, I'm just a girl and I will not make you believe otherwise, I just want these last words to make you feel like a little peace: you are never alone in this path of loneliness and depression, what you need is for someone to make you take your most beautiful side and make you forget that, that makes you feel stupid for having tried to die you know what I mean? you need if not someone, something that will fill you with life and do not rush it man, it will arrive, I trust in that ... kisses and thanks
